title: 6G Mobile Communications for Multi-Robot Smart Factory
authors: Zhenyi Chen and Kwang-Cheng Chen and Chen Dong and Zixiang Nie
problem: The paper addresses the technological challenges presented by smart factories, particularly the limitations of current mobile communication technologies like 5G for collaborative multi-robot systems.
method: The authors propose a framework for smart factories that integrates collaborative multi-robot systems with wireless networks, analyzing the requirements for 6G mobile communication to enhance efficiency and performance.
result: The findings highlight that 6G wireless communication is vital for overcoming the limitations of 5G in smart factories, enabling real-time, high-reliability communication necessary for dynamic multi-robot operations.
